title: Increasing Tangential Gain
statement: Increase the tangential gain to allow the robot to navigate tighter turns more effectively.
mechanism: The tangential gain influences the robot's ability to maintain a straight path while turning, which is crucial for navigating tight turns in a chicane.
contradicting_evidence: Experiment plan_blind_1: Observed delta=+0.000. Verdict: inconclusive (). (Did not produce statistically distinguishable change)
